- [HCG Foundation](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/): HCG Foundation supports cancer patients with financial aid, screening camps, counselling and awareness. 80G approved. Donate and give hope today.
- [About HCG Foundation](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/about-us): HCG Foundation helps cancer patients with financial support, early detection camps, counselling and awareness programs. Learn about our mission.
- [The Patient Aid Support Process](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/patient-aid): HCG Foundation helps financially challenged cancer patients with treatment estimates, hospital discounts and fundraising. See how to refer a patient.
- [Cancer Awareness & Screening Camps](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/awareness-and-screening-camps): HCG Foundation organises cancer awareness and screening camps to help communities spot early signs and get checked in time. Learn more.
- [Swasthi Art Gallery & Art Therapy](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/swasti-art-gallery): Swasthi Art Gallery raises funds for cancer patients, and its art therapy sessions let patients create, reflect and express feelings. Visit the gallery.
- [Pink Hope Patient Support Group](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/pink-hope-support-group): Facing breast cancer? You don't have to do it alone. Pink Hope connects patients with survivors who understand, listen and share hope.
- [Innovation and Technology](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/innovation-and-technology): Learn about HCG Foundation's research and innovation work in cancer care. Details are coming soon, so check back for updates.
- [CSR Partnership for Cancer Care](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/csr-partner): Make your CSR count in cancer care. Fund a program and get quarterly impact reports, or donate, sponsor or volunteer with HCG Foundation.
- [Cancer Philanthropy and Grants](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/grant-and-philanthropy): Support cancer care through grants and philanthropy. Partner to expand access to treatment and create meaningful impact for patients and communities.
- [Volunteer, Fundraise & Intern](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/participate): Your time and skills can bring hope to cancer patients. Volunteer, fundraise or intern with HCG Foundation and make an impact. Apply now.
- [Transparency & Annual Reports](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/transparency-and-knowledge-hub): See where your support goes. Explore HCG Foundation's annual reports and the impact of our cancer awareness, patient support and community care.
- [Projects](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/projects): Explore HCG Foundation's projects in cancer care, from patient financial aid and screening camps to mobile clinics and HPV vaccination drives.
- [Events](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/events): Cultural charity events like Arambh and Sur Sandhya raise funds and awareness for cancer care. Be part of the next HCG Foundation event.
- [Patient Testimonials](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/testimonials): Hear from patients and families whose journeys inspire us. Read HCG Foundation's testimonials and see the hope, courage and care behind every story.
- [Cancer Patient Stories](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/patient-stories): Read the stories of cancer patients HCG Foundation is helping. See their journeys, understand their needs and support a patient's treatment today.
- [Contact Us](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/contact): Need patient support or want to partner with HCG Foundation? Reach our team by phone, email or message. We reply as soon as possible.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.hcgfoundation.org/privacy): Read how HCG Foundation collects, uses and protects your personal information when you donate, volunteer or contact us.
